label: The vision
title: Your future has a next step.
narration: Every student has a destination. The difficult part is knowing what to do next, right now. LumaPath turns that uncertainty into a clear, realistic path.

label: The problem
title: One student. Too many moving parts.
narration: Academic deadlines, career goals, skill gaps, and personal capacity often live in separate places. Students are left to connect everything themselves.

label: The idea
title: One connected decision.
narration: LumaPath brings those signals together. Rules identify priority and risk. Planning logic finds a realistic time. Clear explanations show the student why.

label: The moment
title: The next best action, made obvious.
narration: Instead of another overwhelming dashboard, the student sees one useful action, the reason it matters, and a manageable plan for today.

label: The response
title: Life changes. The plan adapts.
narration: When a deadline moves or available capacity falls, LumaPath protects urgent work and reschedules flexible learning. The plan changes with the student.

label: The future
title: Progress you can see. Skills you can show.
narration: The career roadmap links learning, practice, and project evidence. Students can see where they are and what to build next.

label: The promise
title: Know what to do next.
narration: Academic success and career growth belong in one plan. LumaPath helps students stay on track and build their future, one achievable step at a time.
